text:
Anna: kicking off prod deploy for release=release-2026.03.20 at 22:10 UTC. running the deploy bot now.
Deploy Bot: deploy request received from @Anna for release-2026.03.20 -> starting canary.
Deploy Bot: ERROR: unauthorized to deploy to prod. missing role: 'prod-deployer'. (audit_id=adf83)
Anna: huh — I definitely used the same account that deployed last week. got MFA on. the CLI returned '403: role not found'.
Mike: who currently has prod deploy rights? I thought SRE + Eng Leads had it.
Jordan: SRE leads + Eng Leads historically. recent audit suggested removing broad team access. maybe that change hit yesterday.
Lisa: we rotated the 'prod-deployer' IAM group last night as part of the least-privilege rollout. I can re-add Anna temporarily but want to discuss policy first. :lock:
Kevin: big :+1: on tightening, but we need a clear emergency path. what's current escalation for rollback if oncall can't deploy?
sre-oncall: FYI I can trigger rollback via runbook if a deploy is actively failing (we use the emergency-rollback playbook), but I don't have permissions to perform standard deploys.
Anna: can someone grant me 'prod-deployer' for this rollout window? it's a low-risk canary, just small traffic.
Jordan: proposal: require membership in 'prod-deployer' group + MFA + 2FA device registration. no console-only access. also pin deploys so only CI artifact hashes allowed, not 'latest'.
Mike: agree on pinning. we had a drift incident where 'latest' picked up an untested build. pinning by SHA would reduce blast radius.
Lisa: ops note: adding users to prod-deployer requires approval from Eng Leads + SRE lead. we can do a fast-track for incidents: SRE lead + one Eng Lead sign-off via Slack thread is sufficient and audited.
Anna: tagging @Jordan @Mike — can you two sign off for Anna for this window? the deploy bot is blocked.
Jordan: I approve temporary add for Anna until 23:30 UTC. will monitor canary.
Mike: I approve as well. please annotate audit ticket: #AUD-472.
Deploy Bot: Grant recorded -> user=Anna role=prod-deployer granted_by=Jordan,Mike expires=1710502200 (23:30 UTC).
Anna: thanks — re-running deploy.
Deploy Bot: canary started. instances: svc-a v2.1.3 -> v2.2.0 (pinned sha: sha256:3a5f...). streaming logs: https://ci.internal/build/3a5f
Anna: noticed warnings in healthcheck for svc-b during canary (small spike in 5xx). holding at 10% traffic.
Kevin: recommend pause and investigate, if 5xx persists rollback. prefer rolling back the single service not the entire release.
Lisa: agree. if you need rollback, follow playbook: `# rollback to pinned sha: deploy-tool rollback --service svc-b --sha sha256:...`
Anna: we decided to pause. can we add a permanent rule: only members of prod-deployer group + MFA + commit-pinning allowed for prod deploys, and any regrant must be recorded with ticket id and expires within change window?
Jordan: that policy sounds good. I'll draft a PR to the deploy governance doc and propose enforcement in CI (block deploys that aren't pinned).
Mike: also add a changewindow enforcement: disallow non-emergency deploys outside 22:00-02:00 UTC for production unless Eng/SRE lead approves.
Anna: sounds good. re: MFA, can we require hardware keys (u2f) for prod-deployer? higher bar but less phish risk.
Lisa: we can make hardware keys recommended and require at next security review. short term require enrolled MFA + temporary 2FA device registry.
Deploy Bot: canary healthy at 10% after 14m, no further 5xx. continuing rollout -> completing in 12m.
Anna: rollout completed. thanks for fast approvals and monitoring.
Jordan: follow-up tasks: PR for policy, CI gating for SHA pin, update runbook with the expedited regrant steps. I'llown the PR.
Mike: I'll open a changelog ticket to inform customers about stricter deploy governance next week.
Anna: closing thread. audit ticket #AUD-472 updated with approvals and times. :white_check_mark:
